_note: AI Lifeline corrections ledger (added 2026-09-03). One row per correction: automatic revisions recorded by the daily change ledgers of each edition (a provisional value replaced by a different final value; a same-day re-run that produced a different set of items) and corrections recorded by the editorial team on the operator page (with the definition-document revisions). Facts only: what changed, old, new, reason, source URL, when recorded, and where the underlying ledger row lives. Nothing is deleted from the underlying ledgers.

kinds.value_revision: a published value was replaced (e.g. provisional -> final from a refetch)
kinds.rerun_revision: a same-day re-run produced a different set of change items; earlier rows are kept
kinds.editorial_correction: a correction recorded by the editorial team on the operator page after verification against the primary source
kinds.definition_revision: an indicator definition document changed version (old series kept alongside)
